changelog: The proof-of-origin token is stored but no longer shown. Nobody types it - a television mints it and posts it - so there was nothing to show, and showing it was worse than useless: the configuration page posts back the whole configuration as it was when the page loaded, so opening the page before a television minted and saving it afterwards for some unrelated reason wiped the stored token. The field is gone, and any save that has forgotten the token now has it filled back in rather than clearing it. Ask GET /LiteTv/PoToken whether one is held; it answers without disclosing it.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
